The Exa place page re-read on 2026-09-30 uses the category line Heating, Ventilating and Air Conditioning Contractor. Neither line is an official service menu, and ventilation is not an approved page. A separate hours directory (timetoopen) was not used as a service menu because its page mislabeled the country and invented commercial claims. Furnace association for the approved page rests on the human-approved job plus the winter heating comment, not on a fetched official service list.

Discovery listing count is 11. The Apify run was configured for at most 5 reviews per listing and no finalist enrichment. Review text was not in the normalized export, and the dataset could not be re-read without APIFY_API_TOKEN. This inventory is that display, not a complete 11-review inventory and not the Apify sample. Displayed reviews address Dave, Dave Moore, and Mr.Moore. A search snippet called Dave Moore the owner, but that directory page was blocked by a bot wall and was not fetched. Owner title is not confirmed.
No official service-area list was found. One displayed review mentions rentals in Lebanon. The packet service area stays Lebanon, Missouri.
No hours were confirmed from a fetched official page or a consistent directory page.

On 2026-09-30 the Exa place page and Merchant Circle were re-read. Both show the name Moore Heating & Cooling and the address 22 Glenridge St, Lebanon, MO 65536. That is name-and-address corroboration between those two pages and the stored discovery name. It is not an independent full Google verification of placeId ChIJP1KNzm45xYcRFL7_8I0jLR0.
